{{Quote|There is no place more sacred to the Jedi.|[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="TCW:TG" />}}
The '''Crystal Cave''' of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] was a legendary pilgrimage site for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] from the time of their discovery circa [[22,800 BBY]] until the destruction of the Order in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Located deep within the side of Ilum's largest mountain range, the cave system stretched untold kilometers into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and contained a wealth of precious [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] which were vital to the construction of the Order's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Erecting a [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Temple]] at the mouth of the cave, Ilum's caves became a traditional journey point for many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] over the centuries.

==Description==
{{Quote|The crystals are deep within. To reach them, you will have to pass through visions and voices. Some of them may frighten you. Some of them are drawn from your own past. They are your deepest fears. That is what you must face.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="PTT">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CrystalCaveEntrance-TG.png|thumb|left|250px|Yoda presents the way into the caves from the Jedi Temple]]
Located within Ilum's largest mountain range, the Crystal Caves were a potentially tens of thousands of kilometers-deep labyrinth of winging tunnels, bottomless shafts, and narrow corridors that wended their way through the heart of the mountains and deep below the surface of the planet. Despite their importance to the Jedi Order during the millennia over which they were mined, the caves' total area remained unknown. The Jedi kept charts of the paths near the entrance, but beyond that was a series of dead-ends, crevasses, or a maze of confusing, winding passageways. The largest natural entrance to the caves is the site of the Order's primary [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] facility on the world. The interior of the caves were made of natural shiny black stone; a volcanic rock that swallowed light instead of reflecting it. As time progressed and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] grew, the many Jedi that visited the cave recorded their histories on its walls. A variety of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] grew unimpeded in the walls, floors, and ceilings of the tunnels, and could easily be removed by hand or with hand-held excavation equipment. In some areas the crystals were so common they littered the floor.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

The caves themselves were a powerful nexus of [[Force energy]], creating a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] within the Force itself. Due to the potency of the Force within the close confines of the caves, the place had a disorienting effect that was high distressing to most who entered into the depths. Many who entered suffered from vivid hallucinations, and the occasional Jedi has been lost forever in the darkness. Another effect that the caves often created in the minds of the young Jedi searching for their first lightsaber crystal masked the presence of the crystals. Padawans would journey through the tunnels following the Force to the crystal that called to them, and only that one was visible to their eyes.<ref name="TCW:TG">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Why did the Jedi choose such a hazardous spot to keep the Ilum crystals?''"<br />"''The crystals grow in a cave at the top of this cliff. That is where we must gather them. The challenge is part of the reward.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="PTT" />}}
[[File:Crystal_Caves.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Jedi Temple constructed at the mouth of the caves.]]
Discovered by scouts for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] circa [[22,800 BBY]], the frozen world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] was discovered to hold a number of hidden treasure troves where [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] grew naturally. These crystals, prized for their usage as a focus lens in the Order's symbolic weapon, the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], encouraged the Jedi to found a [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Temple]] and training ground at the mouth to these caves so that members of the Order could mine the rare [[Adegan crystal/Legends|kathracite]], [[Adegan crystal/Legends|mephite]], and [[Adegan crystal/Legends|pontite]] crystals.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the Republic the caves were taken by the Empire in a swift [[Battle of Ilum (Great Galactic War)|battle]]. As the Empire began to garrison troops on the world, the Temple was made inaccessible and, due to thinly-stretched resources, the Order was unable to reclaim it for over a decade.<ref name="TOR" /> Following the destruction of the Sith Empire the Order restored their Temple on Ilum and once more maintained a small group of Jedi on the planet to protect their coveted crystals.<ref name="PTT" />

The Caves were once more made inaccessible several millennia later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a deadly conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During a [[Ambush on Ilum|skirmish]] between Confederate [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] and Jedi, several bombs were placed throughout the Temple and damaged the entrance to the caves.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 16">{{CW|16}}</ref> Following the attack, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] determined that the coordinates to the secret Jedi world were compromised, the Council ordered that all crystals be harvested and taken to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for safe keeping.<ref name="JvS" /> Yet [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] were still taken to the Crystal Caves to find their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] in the ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]].<ref name="TCW:TG" />

As [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was executed by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the Order systematically wiped out, Ilum's prized crystal caves were seized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Blocking access to the Temple at the mouth of the caves, the subterranean depths were largely inaccessible.
In the months following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], two surviving Jedi, [[Fy-Tor-Ana]] and [[Garen Muln]] sought refuge from the in the Crystal Caves. Fy-Tor-Ana eventually left for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], while Muln remained behind. [[Ferus Olin]] rescued Muln a few months later.<ref name="DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>
